scope: change.hardware_channel_attributes rising-edge hardware interrupt (HardwareInterruptRisingEdgeActive plus the HardwareInterruptRisingEdgeInterrupt OB link) on a DI 16x24VDC HF V1.0 submodule channel of an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1, with typed refusals, device compile, configured-hardware preservation, enable/disable and checkpoint restore; sim_event OB40 on one owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 CPU1511 instance, plus the PLCSIM gaps rerun (online download, virtual time, OB82/OB83/OB86, memory reset, storage). Frozen Debug build of 807a1891 in artifacts/ob2.
limitations: One DI 16x24VDC HF V1.0 module, channels 0 and 1, rising edge only; falling edges, priorities, other modules and remote or shared-device modules are not exercised.
OB40 runs on PLCSIM's ProcessEvent for the configured event (Rising edge0, channel 0); a rising edge written to the input tag through sim_write does not raise OB40 (recorded).
One owned PLCSIM Advanced V8 instance on Softbus; runtime is simulated, not physical I/O.

steps: ET 200SP station on the CPU's IO system
inspect the DI channel 0 interrupt attributes
refuse an OB link to a diagnostic error OB
refuse an OB link to a missing block
refuse enabling the interrupt without its OB
read back the DI channel 0 interrupt
refuse an online download without a ticket
refuse an online download applied with compile and save
refresh the PLCSIM tag list after code change
refresh the PLCSIM tag list after layout change, reinitialized
reinitialized values after the layout change
restore the last online download's project checkpoint
timer scenario on the wall clock
timer scenario in virtual time, repeated
RD_SYS_T sees the set virtual system time
record whether a rising edge written to the input raises OB40
refuse a malformed event before the runtime call
memory reset restarts the loaded program with start values
refuse retrieve with a wrong hash
refresh the PLCSIM tag list after the retrieve
the retrieved card runs the online-downloaded program
enable, disable and restore channel 1's hardware interrupt
refuse disabling the interrupt with an OB link
